analyst_test: A strong analyst who conforms every return and reads every field correctly sums each source's June-to-September phosphorus into the lake over 2024 to 2026, applies each programme's removal and funds chemical phosphorus removal at the Brathwick works (about 340 kg a season against about 220 for the Hollinsby tertiary stage), because it treats every input as reaching the water the bloom grows in.

driver: The decisive quantity is how much of each source's input reaches the layer of the receiving body that the response draws on during the window, decided day by day by comparing the input's own physical state with the receiving body's layered state in a second record; an input denser than the responding layer sinks below it and feeds nothing until the window closes, so summing the inputs, or summing them over the window, credits the sources whose water sinks.
driver_concrete: Each programme's phosphorus kept out of Selwith Water's 0 to 5 m surface water in June to September, counting an inflow's load only on the days its water is no denser than the surface water at the buoy: the spring-fed Lenning runs colder than the surface water on every summer day and plunges below the thermocline (the buoy's conductivity carries it at 8 to 11 m), so the Brathwick works and the farms add nothing to the bloom's water, while the Hollinsby works' warmer effluent enters it.
stump: A competent solver builds each source's June-to-September phosphorus load into Selwith Water from the station, the sampler and the two works' returns, applies each programme's credited reduction and funds chemical phosphorus removal at the Brathwick works (359 kg a season against 222 for the Hollinsby tertiary stage), because it counts every input to the lake as added to the surface water; the step that lands it there is never setting the Lenning's daily temperature against the lake's profile, which shows the river denser than the surface water on every summer day and entering below the thermocline.

differentiation.task487: task487 dates undated release events from how often each kind is found against the inspection window's length; here nothing is undated or inspected, each inflow's recorded load is kept or set aside day by day by whether its water is denser than the lake's surface water, a physical comparison of two continuous records.
differentiation.task308: task308 v1 rebuilds unmet requests that leave no row from second-by-second supply; here every input is recorded in full and the step decides which recorded inputs reach the layer the bloom draws on, so no missing record is rebuilt.
differentiation.task258: task258's reach is a fixed property of each page that limits where a fix acts; here reach is decided day by day by an inflow's density against the lake's temperature profile and decides which sources' inputs count at all.
differentiation.task303: task303 removes events every sibling unit recorded in the same minute as an upstream supply loss; here nothing is removed by simultaneity, each inflow's own load is kept or set aside by comparing its temperature with the lake's layered temperature.

lineage.niche: a corporate-endowed relief foundation's per-award referral ceiling for one-off household relief grants that accredited community partners award and claim back monthly in aggregate, where only a minority of partners claim award by award on the foundation's new case-level portal
lineage.driver: The decision cuts a distribution over items, and the only item-level figure the record states is each unit's own average over its items, so the distribution of unit averages carries the spread between units and none of the spread within them and every upper cut comes out far too low; the within-unit shape is recovered from a minority of units that reported item by item, where the record itself forces that shape to be scale-free rather than additive and to be used as measured rather than as a fitted smooth curve, and any route that pools or rescales the reporting minority fails to reproduce the averages the record states for every other unit.
lineage.stump: A competent solver parses every claim return, supersedes the revised months, fixes the partner crosswalk, builds each partner-band's own average award from the totals and counts, cuts that distribution at the committed share, solves the reference ceiling back through the equivalence scale and the rounding rule and files a ceiling that would refer about a third of the scheme's awards; a solver who finds the portal corpus and pools its awards as they stand files a lower ceiling still, one who rescales the corpus by a single portfolio ratio files a ceiling near the mark, and one who rebuilds per partner but smooths the award shape into a lognormal at the portal's coefficient of variation files the rung immediately below the golden.
lineage.fate: spent: architecture 1 (the Banahaw Relief Foundation's per-award referral ceiling, PHP 7,800) and its 2026-10-18 re-root of the graded quantity (v2, PHP 8,000) were sent back by the determinism judge (NOT_DETERMINISTIC, SEND_BACK: underspecified_objective with margin fragility) and the ask layer measured over the bar twice; architectures 3 to 5 (2026-10-20 to 10-23) and the 2026-11-01 anomaly draw were refused before any card (31 anomaly structures dead on the corpus); the author re-tasked the number to Root-Cause Analysis on 2026-11-01
